name: Vijay Mane
cta_lines: EC2, VPC, IAM, Linux and incident RCA.

process.title: Triage
process.text: Read the ticket, check impact and SLA, and find out what changed. The incident notes start here so the next person can pick up where I leave off.

process.title: Scope
process.text: Confirm the fault from the user’s side, then work out whether it affects one client, one server or the whole network path.

process.title: Trace
process.text: Follow the path with ping, nslookup, ipconfig and logs. When the cause is not obvious, I capture packets with Wireshark or scan with Nmap.

process.title: Fix
process.text: Apply the fix and verify it with the user. If the issue keeps coming back, I script it with Python or PowerShell over WinRM.

process.title: Document & escalate
process.text: Write up findings and the root cause. If it needs a higher team, escalate with full notes and next steps.

projects.title: IT Self-Service Recovery Portal
projects.text: Self-healing agent for recurring fixes (VPN MTU, Citrix sessions, cache cleanup, certificates) plus a console that runs scripts over WinRM from tickets.

projects.title: OpsPulse
projects.text: FastAPI service that loads synthetic incident data into SQL and serves REST endpoints for recurring errors, MTTR and SLA breaches, with tests.

projects.title: AWS VPC + ALB lab
projects.text: Public and private subnets, an ALB, EC2 behind it and least-privilege IAM roles, with a diagram and a short write-up.
